# Built-in templates

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/reference.ts. Do not edit; run `pnpm docs:reference`. -->

A scene names an `engine` and a `template` (or, for the `html` and `hyperframes` engines, its own `html`).
The props of each template are a strict JSON Schema: call `list_templates` (MCP) or `GET /v1/templates` for them,
and `get_capabilities` for the engines that can render on your machine.

Templates marked **Needs your own Remotion licence** use an optional engine that the official image does not include;
it is installed separately with your own Remotion licence. Where it is not installed and turned on, `list_templates` marks
them `available: false` and names the templates to use instead. [Add the Remotion engine](/docs/install/remotion) says how to install it.

| Template | Engine | Duration | What it draws |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kinetic-title` | `remotion` | 1.5-8 s | Bold animated headline (max 60 chars) that springs in word by word, an accent bar and an optional subline. Good as a hook. 1.5-8 s. Optional `media` (a background image or video asset, fit contain, cover or blur-fill, dimmed under the text) and `logo` (an image asset in a corner of the safe area). **Needs your own Remotion licence** (optional engine, not in the official image); without it use `html-title`. |
| `animated-explainer` | `motion-canvas` | 2-20 s | A title followed by 1-4 numbered points revealed one by one; long points wrap. Good for steps or lists. 2-20 s. Optional `media` (a background image or video asset, fit contain, cover or blur-fill, dimmed under the text) and `logo` (an image asset in a corner of the safe area). |
| `html-title` | `html` | 1-12 s | Headline card built from HTML/CSS with an optional kicker and subline, animated with CSS keyframes. 1-12 s. Optional `media` (a background image or video asset, fit contain, cover or blur-fill, dimmed under the text) and `logo` (an image asset in a corner of the safe area). |
| `remotion-layout` | `remotion` | 3 frames to 60 s | Layout of panes: full frame, split screen (2-4 panes, side by side or stacked, with ratios), picture-in-picture (corner, width and margin in units from the safe area) or grid (n x m, or chosen per frame). Each pane holds an image or video asset with a fit mode (contain, cover, blur-fill), a colour, a label, a headline and body text; an optional lower third (name, title, brand colours) sits in the safe area. Sizes are in layout units (1 % of the shorter side), so the scene reflows for every output size and variant. 3 frames to 60 s. **Needs your own Remotion licence** (optional engine, not in the official image); without it use `html-layout` or `hyperframes-layout`. |
| `motion-canvas-layout` | `motion-canvas` | 3 frames to 60 s | Layout of panes: full frame, split screen (2-4 panes, side by side or stacked, with ratios), picture-in-picture (corner, width and margin in units from the safe area) or grid (n x m, or chosen per frame). Each pane holds an image or video asset with a fit mode (contain, cover, blur-fill), a colour, a label, a headline and body text; an optional lower third (name, title, brand colours) sits in the safe area. Sizes are in layout units (1 % of the shorter side), so the scene reflows for every output size and variant. 3 frames to 60 s. |
| `html-layout` | `html` | 3 frames to 60 s | Layout of panes: full frame, split screen (2-4 panes, side by side or stacked, with ratios), picture-in-picture (corner, width and margin in units from the safe area) or grid (n x m, or chosen per frame). Each pane holds an image or video asset with a fit mode (contain, cover, blur-fill), a colour, a label, a headline and body text; an optional lower third (name, title, brand colours) sits in the safe area. Sizes are in layout units (1 % of the shorter side), so the scene reflows for every output size and variant. 3 frames to 60 s. |
| `hyperframes-layout` | `hyperframes` | 3 frames to 60 s | Layout of panes: full frame, split screen (2-4 panes, side by side or stacked, with ratios), picture-in-picture (corner, width and margin in units from the safe area) or grid (n x m, or chosen per frame). Each pane holds an image or video asset with a fit mode (contain, cover, blur-fill), a colour, a label, a headline and body text; an optional lower third (name, title, brand colours) sits in the safe area. Sizes are in layout units (1 % of the shorter side), so the scene reflows for every output size and variant. 3 frames to 60 s. |
| `hyperframes-title` | `hyperframes` | 1-12 s | Headline and subline as a HyperFrames composition (CSS keyframes seeked by the HyperFrames runtime; no GSAP), rendered locally by the HyperFrames renderer. 1-12 s. Optional `media` (a background image or video asset, fit contain, cover or blur-fill, dimmed under the text) and `logo` (an image asset in a corner of the safe area). |

Scenes with agent-written HTML (`html` or `hyperframes` engine, no `template`) can last 3 frames to 60 seconds and
may hold up to 256 KB of HTML and CSS. They run with no network access: inline every image and font as a `data:` URL.
